Name: Sentinel: When you need to be sure
Description:
Sentinel empowers building owners, tenants, city authorities, first responders and the general public to manage their response to earthquakes based on measured data. It increases the availability of information about the physical state of buildings and the city in real time. Sentinel draws information from a dense network of scientific quality earthquake sensors in a closely-spaced grid across a city.

Sentinel records shaking variability street by street and building by building. Sentinel’s cloud-based processing system instantly compares recorded shaking to the building’s design intent and in NZ, the NZ Building Code Limit States, and communicates the outcome to those managing the response. 

Sentinel action messages are sent immediately to building decision-makers via the Sentinel NZ App. Email and text alerts are available. City-wide summary data helps emergency management teams. A free Public Service lets every individual manage their own response and receive reports of measured shaking at friends and family or work locations.

Sentinel is a direct result of our experiences of living through the Christchurch, Seddon and Kaikoura earthquakes. Our “earthquake decade” showed evidence-based decisions improve safety, reduce business interruption and accelerate economic recovery. A key learning was the high value of precise and targeted information.

2.	Terms & Conditions of Business: Build a strong foundation for client relationships by customizing Terms of Trade, mitigating bad debts and disputes. We provide tailored processes/documentation based on your unique needs, surpassing generic templates.
3.	Privacy Compliance: Safeguard your business by staying compliant with NZ's Privacy Act 2020. We assist in drafting up-to-date privacy policies and training privacy officers/staff for effective implementation.
4.	Debt Resolution: Our team offers Ledger Management services to follow up on overdue accounts on your behalf. Delegate the challenging process of debt collection to experts, saving you stress, time, and confrontation.
Partner with NZBT to protect your business, maintain strong client relationships, and free yourself from financial stress! NZBT provides remote and in-person services throughout the country, offering support whenever you need it. Let us alleviate your financial worries and help you focus on your business.

Name: NZ Golden Visa
Description:
New Zealand’s Active Investor Plus (AIP) Visa,often called the NZ Golden Visa,is one of the world’s most attractive residency by investment programmes. Designed for high-net-worth individuals, it offers a direct path to New Zealand residency for those contributing to the nation’s growth.

The Two Investment Pathways
The programme is structured into two categories, allowing investors to choose the path that best aligns with their risk tolerance and lifestyle:

Growth Category (NZ$5 Million): Focuses on higher-growth assets like direct investments in NZ businesses or NZTE-approved managed funds. This is the fastest route, with a 3-year investment term and a minimal physical presence requirement of just 21 days over three years.

Balanced Category (NZ$10 Million): Offers greater flexibility, allowing for a mix of lower-risk assets like government or corporate bonds, listed equities, and property development. It features a 5-year investment term and a 105-day physical presence requirement.

Why Investors are Choosing New Zealand
Recent updates have sparked a surge in interest due to several key benefits:

Home Ownership: Golden Visa holders can now purchase or build a residential home in NZ (valued at NZ$5M+) even before becoming permanent residents.

No English Test: The English language requirement has been removed, simplifying the path for global families.

Efficiency: 80% of applications receive Approval in Principle within 4 months, with some processing times even faster.

Family Inclusion: The visa covers the primary applicant, spouse, and dependent children up to age 24.

Global Connectivity: Access to a stable, top-tier economy known for government integrity and high quality of life.

Independent Support for Your Journey
NZGoldenVisa.com serves as an independent advisory resource, providing a seamless "one-stop-shop" experience. They connect discerning families with a curated network of trusted partners including the country’s top immigration lawyers
